R4800.summary: Donato Acciaiuoli, Florentine orator in Rome, to Lorenzo de' Medici, seven weeks after the Pazzi conspiracy: the lord of Faenza, like the lord of Forlì, is to stay in his lands and send two squadrons of men-at-arms into the field, and Giovan Francesco Gonzaga will gladly enter Lorenzo's service with at least 80 men-at-arms, asking 7,000 ducats for the troops and 1,000 for himself. Decryption and translation are George Lasry's (report of 17 Oct 2026, quoted whole); the transcription linked is this project's independent one of 24 Sept 2026, on which his key was checked (94.4% agreement), since his own sign-level CTTS transcription is not in the repository.

1478

George Lasry with CTTS and Claude: transcription by Claude and key recovered by Claude (crib analysis).

snip.credit: Archivio di Stato di Siena, Concistoro 2308 fasc. 2 no. 11 p. 2, via DECODE R4800

system: Homophonic substitution: three to five signs for each vowel, one to three for the consonants, a few nulls, and the numerals 80 and 7 written as dotted numbers; no nomenclator (George Lasry's key, 57 distinct signs).
